errors.text_span: 逐渐上升至 x 轴 0.5 附近的值 82.04
errors.evidence: This phrasing suggests that the rising trend of the line ends at x=0.5. However, the line continues to rise after x=0.5, reaching its peak value of 82.13 at x=0.6. Although the next sentence mentions the peak, this part of the description misrepresents the local trend.

The description omits several data points that are explicitly labeled in the chart. It fails to mention the F1 values for x = 0.1 (78.8), x = 0.2 (79.91), x = 0.3 (80.89), x = 0.4 (81.52), and x = 0.9 (79.03). The reference description lists all points, indicating their importance.
The description does not mention the presence of the legend at the bottom of the chart, which labels the orange line as "F1值".
